name: Sewer Skimmer
description: A flat-bottomed electric boat designed to navigate GLMZ's massive storm drain and sewage infrastructure. The tunnel network below the city is large enough to drive a truck through in places, and the Sewer Skimmer takes advantage of this — a low-profile craft that moves through the underground waterways connecting districts without touching the surface. The smell never comes out. The operators are a tight community who know passages beneath the city that no one else does, and they charge accordingly.
propulsion: Electric jet drive, sealed motor housing
speed: 15 km/h in open channels, 8 km/h in tight passages
cost: Φ20-50 per trip. Φ1,500 for a working Skimmer.
autonomy: Manual operation only. The tunnels aren't mapped well enough for automation.
armament: Whatever the operator carries. A sealed flare gun is standard.
common_usage: Underground transit bypassing surface checkpoints, smuggling, emergency evacuation, exploring the deep infrastructure.
story_hooks: A Skimmer operator discovers a new channel that leads somewhere the sewer system shouldn't connect to
The underground waterways are rising, flooding established routes and forcing Skimmer operators into uncharted tunnels
physical_description: A stubby, reinforced aluminum hull painted industrial gray, its flat bottom scarred by years of scraping concrete and rusted rebar. Corroded copper wiring snakes along the gunwales, feeding a jury-rigged electric motor salvaged from industrial equipment, while a cracked lexan windscreen—yellowed and scratched—offers minimal protection from the fetid spray. The deck is ribbed with non-slip grating, stained dark with decades of sewage residue that no amount of scrubbing will lift.
